newsitem.title: USA: Sears withdraws offer for MaxServ.
newsitem.headline: Sears withdraws offer for MaxServ.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck & Co said Tuesday that it has withdrawn its bid of $7 a share for the outstanding shares of MaxServ Inc.
"We've withdrawn our offer and are evaluating all options," a spokesman for Sears said.

Sears said it was prepared to make the offer on January 23 in an effort to move negotiations forward. Sears said it was informed that the offer would not be accepted and therefore on January 27 withdrew it.

On December 5, MaxServ said Sears had expressed an interest in buying all of the outstanding shares that the retailer did not already own. It said Sears owns 64 percent of MaxServ's outstanding common stock.
Officials of Texas-based MaxServ, which provides computer database services, were not immediately available for comment.
Shares of MaxServ closed off 3/4 to six.
